name: Talking About Recipes
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on talking about recipes — practice these key phrases out loud:
How do you make this dish?
First, you sauté the onions until golden.
Then add the tomatoes and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
You can substitute butter with olive oil if you'd like.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
